goal: Reject unrecognized options in sendall so callers do not silently misconfigure transaction parameters
Prevents accidental spending of all wallet UTXOs or unintentional broadcast from typos in options
agreement: Unaddressed objection: removing solving_data without deprecation is a breaking change (polespinasa)
Concept approval with testing of option validation (vicjuma)
Approval without stated reasons from account with no project history (Conradgabe)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because misspelled RPC options can cause accidental spending of all wallet funds instead of targeted UTXOs
Inadvertently broadcasting transactions due to typoed flags poses an active fund-safety and operational risk
